messages:
maria: skyline reported streaming breakages during a demo — client shows JSON.parse errors when SSE stream is busy.

skyline-dev: observed sudden disconnects and half events: browser console shows 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Happens after heavy paste.

sam: which region/model? any router deploys recently?

maria: hosted-us-west, model=redwood-2-xl, route=/v1/stream. no direct deploys but router flags changed earlier (aggregation enabled).

eng-oncall-bot: note: feature `stream.write_aggregation` flipped on for edge pool at 2026-03-20T10:05Z.

eli: aggregation can change flush timing. If an intermediate proxy cuts mid-write we get truncated SSE events. Client is using naive `JSON.parse(ev.data)`.

skyline-dev: their infra uses a corporate proxy that enforces small idle timeouts.

sam: quick fixes: 1) tenant flag to disable aggregation for skyline; 2) router ensure `

` event terminator and flush per event; 3) ask client to parse on `

` boundary or use our SDK.

maria: can eng toggle per-tenant? we need a POC patch.

eli: yes, pushing `stream.write_aggregation=false` for org=skyline now. Also adding explicit event terminator on final chunk.

eli: pushed. skyline please retest.

skyline-dev: re-tested: much improved, only an automatic reconnect once, no parse errors. Thanks.

maria: action items: eng keep override for 24h, devex send resilient SSE snippet, sales note perf/cost impact. follow-up demo tomorrow 09:00 PST.
